verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge's own docs describe agents writing and updating pages, adding notes, searching scoped pages, and listing pages via a `knowledge_list` tool, with edits visible to running agents on their next turn. That covers add, search, and update mid-conversation. Deletion appears only as an owner-role permission, not as an agent-invoked tool. Missing for 10: explicitly documented agent-callable delete tool, named write/update/search tool references, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can manage its own memory mid-conversation — adding, searching, updating, and deleting memories through tools or API calls it invokes itself

citations.quote: With Knowledge, an agent can not only read information but update it too, allowing it to learn and self-improve over time.
For updates, the agent writes the page to the scope that matches the request.
People and agents can add notes without rewriting the page.
Search only returns pages the run can read
`knowledge_list` lists the pages in a scope.
an owner can also delete pages and move them between scopes.
Edit it, and running agents get the new version on their next turn.
